summary: A new code path writes a stored datetime in ISO form while every other writer of that column uses the SQL datetime form.
must_agree: The value written to maintenance.last_start_date uses the SQL datetime form every other datetime write uses (R.isoDateTime / R.isoDateTimeMillis, or dayjs .format(SQL_DATETIME_FORMAT)), not toISOString(), which MariaDB rejects.
